data.name: Gregory
data.gender_notes: Gregory is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek grēgoreō, 'to watch, be vigilant'. Its root is Greek grēgoreō (γρηγορέω). Saint Gregory the Great, pope. Gregory is a Greek name meaning “Watchful; vigilant”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gregory expresses “Watchful; vigilant”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Greek grēgoreō, 'to watch, be vigilant'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gregory total 50, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
